messages.subject: node names
parts:
Paul

I keep running into this problem, and perhaps other people do too.
When opening a previously-saved cytoscape file, or after creating a
new window with createWindowFromSelection(), the node names are
"ValidatedObjectAndEditString: validatedObject=TNK2, editString=null"
- which makes it impossible to setNodePosition, selectNodes, etc. Is
there a way around this problem?

Thanks,

Mark
